outputs: Natural language descriptions of the environment and reasoning traces/action plans for embodied tasks.
execution trajectory T = ⟨V 0 , a 0 , V 1 , a 1 , . . . , V T , a T ⟩, where a t is the action taken by the agent at time step t

quote: we report four evaluation metrics on AFLRED: (1) Success Rate (SR); (2) Goal Condition (GC) ... (3) path length weighted SR (PLWSR) ... (4) path length weighted GC (PLWGC) ... report SR on ALF-World.

Following , we report four evaluation metrics on AFLRED: (1) Success Rate (SR); (2) Goal Condition (GC), the ratio of goal conditions completed at the end of an episode; (3) path length weighted SR (PLWSR), the SR weighted by (path length of the expert trajectory)/(path length taken by the agent); (4) path length weighted GC (PLWGC), the GC weighted by the same factor.
